name: obsidian-talktalk
description: Obsidian plugin: run and highlight TalkTalk code blocks with WebAssembly

scripts.test: esbuild test/tokenizer.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:obsidian --outfile=node_modules/.tmp/tokenizer.test.cjs --log-level=warning && node node_modules/.tmp/tokenizer.test.cjs && esbuild test/wasm.test.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --loader:.wasm=base64 --outfile=node_modules/.tmp/wasm.test.cjs --log-level=warning --log-override:empty-import-meta=silent && node node_modules/.tmp/wasm.test.cjs
